nodes.label: Do Not Run php artisan config:cache in Production
nodes.norm_label: do not run php artisan config:cache in production
nodes.rationale: With the current Livewire/Filament version combination, config:cache has caused the served HTML's Livewire asset hash to diverge from the cached route table, breaking the admin login flow. route:cache and view:cache remain safe.

nodes.label: Explicit Container Names Required for fastcgi_pass
nodes.norm_label: explicit container names required for fastcgi_pass
nodes.rationale: Docker DNS can resolve a generic hostname like app:9000 to either the prod or staging PHP-FPM container when both share a network, causing random cross-contamination (wrong session cookies, mismatched Livewire asset hashes, intermittent 404s). Explicit container names (ochoa2_app:9000, ochoa2_staging_app:9000) avoid this ambiguity.

nodes.label: User Model Must Implement FilamentUser Contract
nodes.norm_label: user model must implement filamentuser contract
nodes.rationale: Filament\Models\Contracts\FilamentUser with canAccessPanel() must be implemented on the User model because Filament blocks panel access by default outside the local environment without it.

nodes.label: Filament FileUpload Must Set disk("public")
nodes.rationale: Laravel's default local disk root changed in recent versions; without explicitly setting ->disk("public") on Filament FileUpload components, uploads can silently land in a non-web-accessible location.

nodes.label: Docker "not a directory" Mount Error for default.conf
nodes.norm_label: docker "not a directory" mount error for default.conf
nodes.rationale: When docker/nginx/default.conf doesn't exist locally (e.g. after pulling a commit that removed it from git tracking), Docker auto-creates an empty directory in its place, causing a 'not a directory' mount error. Fix: remove the auto-created directory with sudo and copy default.conf.example to default.conf.

nodes.label: OPcache Dev Settings (validate_timestamps/revalidate_freq)
nodes.rationale: The Dockerfile sets opcache.validate_timestamps=1 and revalidate_freq=0 for dev so file changes are picked up immediately; if stale-code symptoms appear after a deploy, docker compose restart app forces a clean reload.

nodes.label: Shared nginx default.conf Across Environments
nodes.rationale: docker/nginx/default.conf is shared across local dev, staging, and production; editing it for one environment can silently break another. If a server-specific fastcgi_pass value leaks onto develop/main and is pulled onto a fresh dev machine, ochoa2_web crash-loops with 'host not found in upstream'. TODO: split into environment-specific nginx configs mounted directly on servers, not committed shared files.

nodes.label: trustProxies Middleware Configuration
nodes.rationale: Without $middleware->trustProxies(at: '*') in bootstrap/app.php, Laravel doesn't trust the X-Forwarded-Proto header from Nginx Proxy Manager and generates http:// URLs even when served over HTTPS, causing mixed-content browser errors.
